layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers to simulate architectural white-space.
layout.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for pills/buttons.
layout.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0 or #D1DCD3 for architectural cardless look.

components.navigation: Locked top nav bar. Glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80. High contrast links.
components.buttons: Primary CTA: bg-[#183021] text-white hover:bg-[#2C4A3B] transition-colors. Secondary: bg-[#F5F3ED] text-[#183021] hover:bg-[#D1DCD3].
components.cards: White background, subtle 1px border. No heavy drop shadows by default. Use geometric layout.
components.tabs: Sliding pill highlight using Framer Motion layoutId.
components.data_tables: Geometric sans-serif (Outfit). Left aligned. Generous row padding. Muted text for secondary data.

rules.counters: Use AnimatePresence and layout animations for ROI and credit balances.
rules.page_transition: opacity: 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0 on entry.

images.description: Large array of solar panels in a desert. Use for Pavagada/Bhadla farm hero or marketplace cards.
White windmills during daytime. Use for Muppandal/Jaisalmer farm marketplace cards.
Aerial view of a green forest. Use for CO2 saved / Trees equivalent dashboard impact card.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='buy-shares-button', data-testid='roi-slider').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Premium Light Theme (Organic & Earthy). Do NOT use dark or navy backgrounds anywhere.
Implement Framer Motion for value counters in the ROI calculator and balances, and sliding pill tabs.
Use Cormorant Garamond for main numbers and headings, and Outfit for tabular data, forms, and secondary text.
Use pure CSS/Tailwind for structural layout and Shadcn components only where logical (e.g., Dropdowns, Modals). Customize Shadcn to remove generic styling.
Ensure the SVG generation chart on the dashboard is crisp, utilizing the accent colors (Pine or Terracotta).
Install Google Fonts for 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' in index.css.
